name: Notification Blocker
author: Hamdi Saidani

sections.description:
Notification Blocker is a lightweight and powerful WordPress plugin that lets you hide and restore all admin notifications with a single toggle switch. It’s perfect for developers, site managers, and anyone tired of noisy dashboards.

Key Features

  • One-Click Toggle – Hide all admin notices with a single switch.
  • Modern UI – Sleek, minimalist design integrated into the WordPress admin.
  • Lightweight & Fast – Built with vanilla JavaScript. Zero performance impact.
  • Multisite Ready – Fully compatible with WordPress Multisite.

How It Works

  1. Go to Settings > Notification Blocker.
  2. Toggle the switch to enable or disable notification blocking.
  3. Enjoy a cleaner, distraction-free dashboard.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the notification-blocker folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > Notification Blocker to configure.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin block all types of admin notices?

Yes. It blocks standard WordPress admin notices, including network-wide and user-specific messages.

Will it hide important warnings or errors?

Yes, it hides all admin notices. Use the toggle to turn it on/off as needed, especially in production.

Is this compatible with WordPress Multisite?

Absolutely.

Does this affect front-end users or notifications?

No, only the WordPress admin area is affected.
